svg.aria-label: Each synthetic, such as AAPLr, has two Morpho markets. The Null Savings Vault lends nUSDC into the long market AAPLr | nUSDC, where Leverage Long traders borrow it against AAPLr. AAPLr holders lend into the short market nUSDC | AAPLr, where Leverage Short traders borrow AAPLr against nUSDC.
